title: Research method for Obesity predicted effector genes (Joslin et al., 2021)
bodyHtml:
These results were generated in the study:

A functional genomics pipeline identifies pleiotropy and cross-tissue effects within obesity-associated GWAS loci.
Joslin AC, Sobreira DR, et al.
Nat Commun. 2021 Sep 6;12(1):5253. doi: 10.1038/s41467-021-25614-3.
PMID: 34489471

Cell type-specific regulatory annotations relevant to obesity were generated using promoter capture Hi-C (cHi–C) to elucidate putative enhancer–promoter interactions, ATAC-seq to identify open chromatin, and RNA-seq to measure global gene expression levels. The cell types assayed were human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) at three time points during differentiation into mature hypothalamic neurons, and non-immortalized Simpson–Golabi–Behmel syndrome (SGBS) human preadipocytes at four time points during differentiation into mature white adipocytes.

A massively parallel reporter assay (MPRA) was applied to the lead SNPs and variants in high LD with them at 97 independent BMI-associated GWAS loci (identified by Locke AE, Kahali B, Berndt SI, Justice AE, et al., 2015) to identify putatively causal enhancer-modulating variants (EMVars).

Genes were classified in adipose and brain cells as follows:

Class 1 (greatest amount of evidence supporting the potentially causal role of the gene for obesity in that tissue):

  • an EMVar interacts with the gene
  • AND the EMVar is a GTEx eQTL for the gene in the appropriate cell type (GTEx adipose tissues for adipose EMVars and GTEx Brain tissues for Brain EMVars).

Class 2:

  • the gene interacts with an EMVar in the appropriate cHi–C dataset
  • AND the EMVar is an eQTL for that gene in cell types other than the appropriate one

Class 3:

  • the gene interacts with an EMVar in the appropriate cHi–C dataset
  • OR the EMVar is an eQTL for that gene in the appropriate cell type

Class 4:

  • the gene is an eGene for an EMVar in cell types other than the appropriate one

Only genes found to be expressed in this RNA-seq analysis at levels > 1 TPM in at least 1 time point in their respective cell type were considered.
